title: Chicago in a Day Walking Tour: Food, History & Architecture
includes: Hear stories of Chicago’s past from Prohibition to the Great Fire and immigrant history
Led by expert local guides, passionate storytelling from true Chicago insiders
Visit Millennium Park and snap photos at the famous Bean
Explore top sights & hidden gems like Riverwalk, Magnificent Mile, Pedway, Wrigley Building
Taste Chicago’s iconic eats, including deep‑dish pizza, Chicago‑style hot dogs, and Italian beef
Enjoy a relaxed, small‑group experience (maximum 12 travelers)
Travel with purpose on a tour operated by a certified B Corp committed to responsible tourism
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Is this tour child-friendly? Yes! This tour is suitable for families. Children under 4 years old can join free of charge. A reduced child price applies for children aged 4 to 11.

Will food options or portion sizes very? Food offerings and portion sizes may vary depending on the season and the stops visited on the day of the tour. However, the total amount of food included is always designed to equal a full meal.

Is this tour suitable for all ages and fitness levels? Yes! This tour is suitable for guests of all ages and fitness levels. Please note that it includes approximately 4.8 to 6.4 km (3-4 miles) of walking. at a relaxed pace with regular stops.

Can dietary requirements be accommodated? Vegetarian options are available. Unfortunately, we are unable to accommodate other food allergies or dietary preferences. Please let us know in advance if you require a vegetarian option so we can plan accordingly.
What happens if the weather isn’t great? Experiences run rain, shine, or snow, so please dress appropriately for the weather on the day of your tour.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Immerse yourself in Chicago's rich history and vibrant culinary scene on this captivating walking tour. Discover the city's iconic architecture and Prohibition-era charm while indulging in delectable local cuisine. From deep-dish pizza to hidden gems, savor the flavors of Chicago as a knowledgeable guide unveils the city's culinary secrets and fascinating history.
